title: Senior Specialist - Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Administrator
description:
It's about Being What's next.
 **What's in it for you?**

 The Senior Specialist in this position should be a highly skilled Power BI \& Microsoft Fabric Administrator to support and advance our enterprise self service BI strategy. This role focuses heavily on platform and capacity administration, governance, security, and operational excellence within Power BI and Microsoft Fabric. A strong understanding of BI development concepts (datasets, semantic models, dataflows, pipelines) is required to effectively support business publishers and guide self service users. This position also includes limited support for our existing Tableau environment during transition, ensuring continuity while organizational reporting shifts toward Power BI and Fabric.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  


 Making an impact.
 **What will you do?**

* You will be managing and administrating Power BI/ Fabric capacities across Linde
* You will create and maintain workspaces, enforce workspace governance, and assist users with migration to Fabric experiences
* You must have experience with Fabric workload orchestration OneLake management, Lakehouse \& Warehouse provisioning, Pipeline orchestration and monitoring, Fabric capacities and workload configuration (Lakehouse, Warehouse, KQL DB, Notebooks, Data Engineering, Real\-Time Intelligence)
* Proficiency with Power BI Admin APIs, Fabric APIs, and automation frameworks
* Also, strong understanding of Azure AD / Entra ID concepts
* You must have knowledge of Row\-Level Security (RLS) and Object\-Level Security (OLS) design patterns to guide self‑service developers



 Winning in your role.
 **Do you have what it takes?**

* You must have 3–7 years supporting Power BI/Fabric or enterprise BI platforms
* Along with strong understanding of BI development (Power BI datasets, dataflows, semantic models, pipelines)
* Experience with governance and enterprise BI support models
* You must excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills
* And the ability to work with distributed teams and support global users



**Why you will love working for us!**

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com
   

  

 Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
   

  

 We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
   

  

 Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.

The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

title: Tech & Data - System Transformation Data - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Tech \& Data \- System Transformation Data \- Manager, you will play a pivotal role in assisting clients to develop solutions that enhance trust, drive improvement, and manage risk through advanced analytics and technology. Within our Assurance practice, you will focus on providing independent assessments of financial statements and internal controls, enhancing the credibility of information for stakeholders.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will utilize data wrangling technology and automation tools to establish processes that enable clients to make informed decisions based on accurate and trustworthy information.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understanding Data Migration, data governance and data analytics.
* Experience / Exposure to System Transformation (Pre / Post Implementation)Projects for Audit / Non\-Audit clients
* Ability to leverage and possess hands\-on working knowledge of visualization software such as Power BI.
* Applying knowledge of data analysis and manipulation products like SQL, Alteryx, Python, and Databricks.
* Engaging in regulation, workforce, financial reporting, and automation.
* Managing complex internal and external stakeholder relationships.
* Thriving in a dynamic consulting environment, with a desire to grow within this setting.
* Managing client engagements and internal projects, including budgets, risks, and quality assurance.
* Preparing reports and deliverables for clients and other stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining internal and external relationships.
* Identifying and pursuing business opportunities, supporting line management in proposal development, and managing, coaching, and supporting team members.
* Supporting team with engagement scoping and planning activities.
* Coaching team members in task completion.
* Performing advanced data analysis to support test procedures.
* Collaborating effectively with local and regional teams and clients.
* Supporting team in drafting client deliverables for review by Engagement Leaders.
* Managing project economics for engagement teams.
* Conducting basic review activities and providing coaching to junior team members.
* Demonstrates strong critical\-thinking ability to evaluate not just the presence of documentation but its quality, clarity, and completeness—proactively identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.


 What You Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering and Business, Financial Mathematics, Mathematical Economics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, or a related field.
* Minimum Years of Experience: 7\+ years of relevant experience, preferably in a public accounting firm or a large corporation
* 3 years of assurance experience in internal controls and/or business process testing.
* Experience in technology risk (e.g., IT General Controls, information security).
* Previous experience in shared service delivery centers.
* Certifications such as CIA, CISA, or ITIL are preferred.


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Advanced knowledge and understanding of financial risk management, operational risk management, and compliance requirements.
* Proficiency in data analytics tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power BI) and Microsoft suite tools (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Experience with major ERPs such as SAP, Oracle, and/or technology security management.
* Programming skills in SQL, Python, or R.
* Accounting experience and consulting experience.
* Knowledge in financial services is preferable.
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.

title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13)
description:
**Role Title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
   

  

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.


**Organizational Overview**
 The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony oversees key security functions including authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This team ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will oversee a team of seven and be a direct report into the VP, IAM Programs Leader.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 We are seeking an innovative and results\-driven leader to serve as VP, IAM Assurance Leader, responsible for leading the IAM Services Assurance function overseeing key controls across all centralized and decentralized IAM services. This role will work closely with IAM product owners and engineering teams to ensure adherence to Synchrony IAM standards and regulatory requirements without disrupting operational delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and hands\-on experience across IAM controls, assurance operations, and identity/authentication platforms (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP technologies, Beyond Identity, and related IAM services). As a strategic leader, you will guide teams, enable cross\-functional collaboration, and drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness, reporting, and automation of IAM controls—particularly in critical areas such as logical access, authentication assurance, privileged access oversight, and control evidence for SOX/PCI and other regulatory obligations. You will blend technology insight with program management discipline to ensure success in execution and delivery, including the creation and modernization of assurance reporting capabilities and the automation of control remediation where appropriate.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Create and Maintain Strategic Roadmaps: Develop and execute multi\-year roadmaps to drive innovation, strengthen security posture, meet regulatory requirements, and streamline IAM operations—specifically for IAM assurance capabilities, control monitoring, and evidence automation.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships across Security Operations, Technology Teams, Governance, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit, ensuring program alignment, audit readiness, and the ability to clearly demonstrate IAM control effectiveness to stakeholders and regulators.
* Risk and Progress Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and organizational risks while regularly reporting blockers, corrective actions, and program milestones to executive leadership; ensure timely remediation of control gaps and recurring defects.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Lead and contribute to designing technical solutions for complex automation use cases, driving operational efficiency and scalability—especially automation to detect, track, and remediate IAM control defects.
* Program Integrity: Ensure standards, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and officially maintained for audit and compliance requirements; recommend updates to IAM standards based on security threats, regulatory expectations, and industry trends.
* Performance Tracking: Define, implement, and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program maturity and overall effectiveness, including assurance coverage, control pass rates, remediation SLAs, defect recurrence, and reporting timeliness/accuracy.
* Assurance Operations Leadership: Lead assurance activities to track, validate, and remediate key logical access and authentication controls across centralized IAM services (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle LDAP, Beyond Identity) and decentralized implementations as applicable.
* Assurance Reporting Platform Ownership: Manage and evolve the IAM assurance reporting platform(s) used to monitor adherence to Synchrony standards, control design, and operational effectiveness; ensure reporting is accurate, resilient, and audit\-ready.
* Agile Partnership with Product Owners: Partner with IAM product owners and delivery teams using Agile methodologies to prioritize and implement control improvements, balancing risk reduction with service stability and customer impact.
* Control Evidence \& Audit Support: Ensure the organization can efficiently produce high\-quality evidence for SOX, PCI, and other examinations; proactively address audit issues with root\-cause correction and sustainable control improvements.
* Documentation \& Enablement: Oversee creation, maintenance, and review of operational process documentation and end\-user/training materials needed to support consistent execution of IAM assurance activities.
* Problem Resolution: Independently resolve technical challenges while escalating issues with clarity when necessary.
* Perform other critical duties or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading multiple IAM service products (e.g., authentication, privileged access, identity governance) and driving outcomes across both centralized and distributed service models.
* Minimum 5 years of experience developing and improving IAM service processes and reporting on IAM service key controls (design and operating effectiveness).
* Minimum 3 years leading operations or assurance teams, including continuous monitoring, issue management, and control remediation.
* At least 2 years working with Agile methodologies in roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Technical Lead.
* Minimum 2 years of people management experience, leading teams of 2\+ engineers or contractors.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of IAM directory services, such as Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle LDAP, or similar.
* Experience with assurance reporting, control monitoring dashboards, and/or metrics platforms used to track compliance and remediation status.
* Hands\-on experience with Security Control Design and Security Assurance Operations, including defining controls, validating operating effectiveness, and driving remediation.
* Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux Server Access Administration and access security.
* Experience supporting or integrating IAM platforms and processes such as ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, privileged access tooling (e.g., Bomgar/BeyondTrust), and authentication technologies (e.g., RSA Authentication Manager or equivalents).


**Skills**
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for effective cross\-team collaboration and executive reporting, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact.
* Strategic thinker able to develop and articulate long\-term program visions and actionable roadmaps.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in complex environments.
* Proactive problem solver with the ability to navigate ambiguity and escalate appropriately.
* Strong analytical and clear\-thinking skills; ability to interpret control results, identify root causes, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Customer\-oriented mindset and ability to reduce friction for product teams while improving assurance outcomes.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Proven experience leading large\-scale IAM initiatives, including program design, execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of creating and executing long\-term strategic roadmaps.
* Strong ability to manage risk and complexity, navigate roadblocks, and drive corrective actions effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage teams while building partnerships across business units and fostering alignment to organizational goals.
* Strong commitment to providing outstanding customer experiences; ability to balance control compliance with minimal operational disruption.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and flexibility to change directions quickly while maintaining delivery discipline.
* Experience with the process of creating, maintaining and reviewing operations process \& end user training documentation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, Active Directory, Bomgar/BeyondTrust privileged access, Unix LDAP, and RSA Authentication Manager (or comparable tools).
* Experience working in highly regulated industries (Finance, Healthcare, Government), particularly enterprise\-level security in a financial institution.
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as SOX, PCI, FFIEC, GDPR, HIPAA, or NIST cybersecurity frameworks, including NIST 800\-63 and logical access control expectations.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or relevant IAM\-focused certifications.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
   

  

**Work Timings** 
 : 9AM \- 5PM EST
   

  

 Role requires collaboration during India and US business hour overlap windows to support leadership and stakeholder discussions.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AIA – Mainframe Modernization Specialist**
**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a skilled
 **Senior Mainframe Modernization Specialist** 
 to join our
 **AI\-Driven Modernization** 
 practice, focused on transforming
 **legacy mainframe systems** 
 into agile, efficient, and cloud\-ready platforms. The ideal candidate will bring a strong blend of
 **mainframe expertise, AI tools proficiency, and cloud technologies** 
 along with
 **hands\-on collaboration** 
 with cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable modernization outcomes.
   

  

 You will work closely with technology leads, architects, and business stakeholders to analyse legacy applications, leverage AI/ML to automate code analysis and refactoring, and execute migration of mainframe workloads to modern distributed and cloud\-native platforms.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence:**
* Mainframe Systems Analysis and Understanding


* 
+ Assess and analyse existing mainframe applications (COBOL, JCL, VSAM, DB2, CICS, IMS) to identify modernization opportunities and dependencies.
+ Document current\-state architecture, data flows, batch schedules, and integration points across legacy ecosystem components.
+ Perform impact analysis and complexity assessment for potential transitions to modern platforms.
+ AI\-Driven Mainframe Modernization


* 
+ Apply AI tools and custom AI agentic workflows for automated code analysis, refactoring, and technical debt reduction.
+ Develop and fine\-tune AI\-powered assistants to accelerate system conversion and code translation (e.g., COBOL to Java/Python).
+ Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to maximise accuracy and efficiency of LLM\-driven modernization workflows.
+ Modernization Execution


* 
+ Execute modernization tasks including rehosting, refactoring, or rebuilding mainframe workloads based on defined strategies.
+ Participate in the design and implementation of target\-state architectures aligned with cloud\-native and microservices patterns.
+ Ensure code quality, testability, and maintainability throughout the modernization lifecycle.
+ API and Microservices Development


* 
+ Contribute to the design and development of API integrations and microservices to replace or wrap legacy mainframe functionality.
+ Implement RESTful APIs, event\-driven architectures, and integration patterns as part of the target\-state solution.
+ Cloud and Platform Integration


* 
+ Support migration of mainframe workloads to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using AI\-driven solutions.
+ Integrate modernized components with cloud\-native services, containerised workloads (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and security best practices for modernized workloads.
+ Documentation and Reporting


* 
+ Create and maintain technical documentation including system designs, migration runbooks, and AI pipeline configurations.
+ Provide regular status updates on modernization progress, risks, and deliverables to project leads.


**Skills and Attributes:**
**Educational Background**
* B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / M.Tech or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.


**Professional Experience**
* 5 to 9 years of hands\-on experience with legacy mainframe systems (COBOL, JCL, Assembler, CICS, DB2, IMS, VSAM).
* Experience with data migration, integration, ETL processes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Proficiency in programming/scripting languages such as Python and/or Java.
* Working knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Hands\-on experience with AI tools, LLM API calls, prompt engineering, and context engineering for automating code analysis and modernization workflows.
* Experience with mainframe modernization tools or platforms (e.g., Micro Focus, AWS Mainframe Modernization, Azure Migrate) is a plus.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear documentation and presentations.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP), AI/ML certifications, or mainframe\-related certifications are a plus.


**Why Join Us**

title: Executive Assistant to the President
description:
**SRMB STEEL** 




  





**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




**Executive Assistant to the President \& CSMO** 




**Position Title** 




 Executive Assistant (EA) to the President \& Chief Sales and Marketing Officer
 



**Reports To** 




 President \& CSMO (single reporting line)
 



**Base Location** 




 Kolkata, Corporate Head Office (anchors HQ operations during principal's field travel)
 



**Function / Band** 




 Executive Office / Business Support (Senior Manager equivalent)
 



**Experience Required** 




 12\+ years as EA to a Director / CXO in a large manufacturing organization (non\-negotiable)
 



**Span of Coordination** 




 Interfaces with 10 direct reports of the CSMO, HODs, plant \& regional sales leadership, and the MD's office
 



  





**1\. Purpose of the Role** 




 SRMB Steel is scaling toward a ₹5,000 Cr turnover ambition, and the Office of the President \& CSMO sits at the centre of that push. This office consolidates every sales, marketing, MIS and analytics stream while the CSMO spends much of the next twelve months in the field, driving the retail run across a digital\-rich, multi\-brand product architecture (core TMT, binding range, structural\-retail brands and the project/institutional business).
 



 The Executive Assistant is the operating spine of this office. Not a diary\-keeper, but a trusted second brain: someone who runs the HQ cockpit when the principal is travelling, keeps information flowing without friction, turns raw data into decision\-ready briefs, and protects the CSMO's time and focus with judgement and discretion. This is a career EA role for a seasoned professional who takes quiet pride in flawless execution.
 



  





**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Executive Office \& Time Management** 



* **Calendar command:** 
 Own the CSMO's calendar end\-to\-end: prioritising, sequencing and defending time against competing demands from HODs, the MD's office, dealers, and external partners.
* **Operating rhythm:** 
 Run the daily and weekly operating rhythm: pre\-empt what the principal needs before each meeting, prepare the day's brief, and close the loop on every open action.
* **HQ anchor:** 
 Act as the HQ anchor while the CSMO is in the field: a reliable point of contact who keeps the office moving, escalates only what matters, and never lets a commitment slip.



**B. Communication \& Gatekeeping** 



* **First point of contact:** 
 Serve as the first point of contact for the office, screening calls, mail and requests with tact, filtering noise, and routing the right matters to the right people.
* **Correspondence:** 
 Draft, edit and dispatch correspondence, notes and communications on the CSMO's behalf in a crisp, professional voice.
* **Representation:** 
 Represent the office of the President with warmth and poise to internal teams, channel partners and senior external stakeholders.



**C. Data, MIS \& Digital Enablement** 



* **MIS consolidation:** 
 Consolidate KRO / Sales\-MIS streams from HODs into clean, single\-source dashboards and review packs, and flag exceptions before they are asked for.
* **Analytics partnership:** 
 Work hand\-in\-glove with the DGM\-level Sales \& Marketing Analytics / MIS SPOC to keep the CSMO decision\-ready while he travels, acting as a data\-fluent proxy for routine review of numbers.
* **Excel \& PPT:** 
 Build and maintain advanced Excel models (pivots, lookups, dynamic dashboards) and craft board\- and review\-grade PowerPoint decks that tell the story at a glance.
* **Digital tools:** 
 Champion the digital toolkit of a digital\-rich organisation (collaboration, task\-tracking, CRM/DMS and reporting platforms) and keep the office's workflows paperless and audit\-ready.



**D. Travel, Field\-Ops \& Meeting Coordination** 



* **Travel:** 
 Plan and orchestrate extensive domestic (and occasional international) travel, covering itineraries, logistics, market visits and dealer meets, with contingency built in.
* **Governance:** 
 Coordinate reviews, town halls and leadership meetings: agendas, pre\-reads, minutes, and rigorous action\-tracking to closure.
* **Administration:** 
 Manage expense reporting, approvals and documentation accurately and on time.



**E. Confidentiality \& Trust** 



* **Discretion:** 
 Handle sensitive commercial, strategic and people\-related information with absolute discretion. This role sees everything, and is trusted to hold it.



  





**3\. Must\-Have Qualifications \& Experience** 



* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 12 years of Executive Assistant experience supporting a Director / CXO / business\-head, of which a substantial part in a large manufacturing organization.
* **Education:** 
 Graduate (any discipline); a business, commerce or secretarial\-practice qualification is an advantage.
* **Context fit:** 
 Proven track record of running a high\-tempo executive office where the principal travels heavily and the EA holds the fort.
* **Domain:** 
 Comfort with the vocabulary and rhythm of sales, distribution, dealers and MIS in a manufacturing/building\-materials setting.



  





**4\. Technical \& Digital Proficiency** 




 Skill on the tools is a threshold, not a bonus. The right candidate is genuinely strong here:
 



**Skill Area Expectation** 




  





**Microsoft Excel** 




 Advanced: pivots, complex formulas, lookups, dynamic dashboards, data clean\-up (must\-have)
 



**Microsoft PowerPoint** 




 Advanced: builds review\- and board\-grade decks independently, clean visual storytelling (must\-have)
 



**MS Word \& Outlook** 




 Expert: formatting, mail\-merge, calendar \& inbox mastery
 



**Collaboration \& PM tools** 




 Fluent in task/project trackers, shared drives, and video\-conferencing platforms
 



**Business systems** 




 Working comfort with CRM / DMS / MIS reporting tools; quick to learn new platforms
 



**AI \& productivity tools** 




 Willing and able to use modern AI assistants to draft, summaries and speed up the office
 



  





**5\. Competencies \& Cultural Fit** 




 This office runs on a specific temperament: humility paired with task\-mastery. Humble in manner, relentless on execution, calm at pace. The EA must mirror that.
 


* **Humility:** 
 Humble and grounded, leads with courtesy and service, ego\-free, treats every colleague and partner with respect.
* **Task\-mastery:** 
 Owns outcomes, not just tasks; follows through to closure without being chased. Nothing falls through the cracks.
* **Proactiveness \& pace:** 
 Anticipates needs a step ahead, brings solutions rather than problems, and moves quickly without dropping quality.
* **Communication:** 
 An outstanding communicator: clear, warm and precise in speech and writing, across every level from shop\-floor to boardroom.
* **Composure:** 
 Unflappable under pressure, adaptable, and dependable in ambiguity.
* **Trust:** 
 Absolute integrity and confidentiality, the office's most trusted keeper of information.



  





 Salary
 



 As per the Industry Standard.

description:
**We are The Future Animations. Our artists animate one of the fastest\-growing story universes on YouTube. The work goes out daily, to millions of people, on channels the audience is genuinely obsessed with.** 




**We are hiring hard because the demand in front of us is bigger than the team that exists.** 




  





**🎬 Role Description** 




  





**Full\-time, fully remote, anywhere in India.** 




**You'll own animation on complete stories. Not a shot, not a task in someone else's file — the animation of a whole video, start to finish, with a lead who reviews your work.** 




  





**📅 A typical week** 




  




* One morning check\-in with your production manager. That's the only standing meeting.
* You animate. Layout, body, expressions, camera.
* Your lead reviews before you start lighting. Notes come back the same day.
* You do the lighting and either render yourself or give us your file and we render for you.
* You work whatever hours suit you. Several of our best artists work at night. We staff leads across time zones so you're never just keep waiting for a review.



  





**🛠️ What we give you so you can actually work** 




  




* Render farm access. Your laptop/PC is not the render machine. Renders don't eat your week.
* NO Lip syncing req to be done from your end. we take care of it.
* A render assistance team for anyone on a slower system.
* An asset and environment library — models, rigs, environments, ready to pull. We buy what we don't have.
* Blender add\-ons built in\-house for texture, file and character optimisation, lighting presets, and cloth, hair and blink passes.
* A named lead who reviews your work and gives you go ahead.
* A 200\+ artist Discord where people actually answer.



  





**💰 Compensation and how you grow here:** 




  





**We pay per finished minute, published openly, in three tiers. Your tier is set by the quality of your work and reviewed every month — not by how long you've been here.** 




  





**Tier 3 — ₹5,000 per finished minute At 8–10 minutes a month, that's ₹32,000–₹40,000\. You get a lead whose job is to push you to Tier 2\.** 




  





**Tier 2 — ₹6,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹60,000–₹72,000\. Your lead keeps working with you toward Tier 1\.** 




  





**Tier 1 — ₹7,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹70,000–₹84,000\. Past 12 minutes you're over ₹1,00,000\. Tier 1 is where we look first when a 3D Lead position opens.** 




  





**Plus a quality bonus on every video that clears our animation guidelines.** 




  





**Two things worth saying plainly.** 




  





**None of our leads earns less than ₹1,50,000 a month. Several of them joined as artists within the last few months. We promote on quality and output, and we promote fast, because we are growing faster than we can hire.** 




  





**Your output is yours. We do not cap what you can earn. An artist producing twenty finished minutes a month earns roughly three times one producing seven. Both are welcome. Only one of them becomes a lead.** 




  





**Payments are monthly, on invoice, on time. Ask anyone in the community.** 




  





**✅ Qualifications** 




  





**You need to be strong in Blender at:** 



* Layout and scene setup
* Character animation — body mechanics, facial expressions.
* Camera animation
* Asset optimisation, and keeping heavy scenes workable
* lighting and rendering.



  





**And you need to be someone who:** 



* Can own a full video without being chased
* Takes direction from a lead and turns it around quickly
* Has taste. Sees the difference between animation that's finished and animation that's good.
* lighting and rendering.



  





 We care about your reel. We do not care about your degree, your city, or how many years you've been doing this. Some of our highest earners had no studio experience before joining.
 



  





 ▶️ The work we make
 



  




* https://youtu.be/YFcFDlAsSO4
* https://www.youtube.com/shorts/bvn8ESiF\-mI
* https://www.youtube.com/shorts/o7pxb\-qOTao



 Watch the character work and the camera. That's the bar.
 



  





 📩 How to apply
 


* Fill the form: https://join.thefutureanimations.com/apply

title: Senior Engineer – Bridges
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
   

  

 Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
   

  

 CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High\-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.
   

  

 CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2\.
   

  

 CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi\-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
   

  

 We are seeking applications for the position of Sr. Lead Engineer \- Bridges for Delhi/Bangalore/Ahmedabad/Kolkata.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Take responsibility for Rail/Road bridge design, viaduct \& Structure design.
* Having experience designing steel structures/bridges with joint detailing.
* Prepare reports and calculations in line with Network Rail standards.
* Should take lead for team of 4\- 5 Junior Engineer’s / Draftsman.
* Plan and deliver bridge surveys and inspections, including recording of all relevant information
* Complete bridge assessment calculation and reporting.
* Manage delivery of projects – take responsibility for budget and resource deployment on projects.
* Where required take responsibility for project delivery to agreed budgets.
* Where required prepare estimates for work items.
* Identify scope change items.
* Manage resources at a project level to ensure utilization and productivity is maintained.
* Ensure compliance of the Systra Group policies, particularly on ethics, safety and adherence to Company ISO Standards.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* BE\-Civil \+ M.Tech in Structural Engineering
* 5 to 10 years of experience into relevant field.
* Experience on Software requirement Sofistick, Midas, Oasys.
* Actively working towards Professional qualification.
* Ability to work in a collaborative multi\-discipline design team.
* Ability to complete assigned tasks with minimal supervision and provide support and mentoring to others.
* Ability to travel to client sites and other SYSTRA offices will be required.


 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!

title: Assoc Clin DB Validation Mgr
description:

Provide leadership and vision to the team in the areas of project planning, execution, and close\-out; financial management; communications; and milestone deliverables. Comply with Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), applicable regulatory guidelines, SOPs, policies, and, where available, CDM guidance documents.
 



 Essential Functions
   

 • Attend Kick Off Meeting and regular project meetings until Study Go Live.
   

 • Take complete responsibility for creation of Edit Checks Test Plan document and writing test cases.
   

 • Release the Edit Checks Test Plan to the testing team to conduct testing activities.

 • Supervise implementation of new technology.
   

 • Serve as primary point of contact for Internal Customers on testing deliverables.
   

 • Provide justification for and perform direct negotiations with Internal Customers, e.g., timelines, financial, process, resources.
   

 • Develop and maintain strong Customer relationships.
   

 • All responsibilities are essential job functions unless noted as nonessential (N).
 



 Qualifications

title: Video Editor
description:
**Role Description** 




 iLEAD Kolkata is looking for a
 **full\-time Social Media Video Editor** 
 who understands how to edit for attention, retention, and platform\-native storytelling.
 



 This role is for someone who is creatively sharp, visually curious, and technically strong, with a strong instinct for
 **Instagram Reels, Facebook content, short\-form videos, digital promos, event content, and campaign\-driven social edits** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who does more than just “follow the brief.”
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to take raw footage, understand the intent, and build a strong fine cut using
 **their own creative judgement** 
 . Someone who knows when to cut faster, when to hold a moment, when motion graphics will elevate an edit, and when they will simply get in the way.
 



 A strong understanding of
 **Instagram\-native editing, current trends, pacing, hooks, transitions, motion graphics, sound design, and visual retention** 
 is essential.
 



 The editor should be confident using
 **Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and CapCut** 
 , and should also have a working understanding of
 **AI tools** 
 that can support editing, ideation, enhancement, clean\-up, subtitles, and workflow efficiency.
 



 And yes, creativity matters.
 



 But so does accountability.
 



 We are looking for someone who can experiment, think independently, and still
 **deliver quality work on time** 
 .
 



 We’re open to a
 **flexible work setup** 
 , including remote work.
 



 What matters to us is simple:
 **good communication, ownership of your edits, and delivering great work on time.** 




 The exact working arrangement can be discussed during the interview based on what works best for the role and the candidate.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Edit
 **high\-quality social media reels** 
 and short\-form videos for digital platforms
* Work on content for
 **Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, campaigns, events, and promotional communication**
* Create edits that feel
 **current, platform\-native, visually engaging, and brand relevant**
* Use
 **Premiere Pro, After Effects, and CapCut** 
 effectively based on project requirements
* Add
 **motion graphics, text animation, transitions, sound design, and finishing polish** 
 where required
* Understand social media behaviour and edit with a strong focus on
 **hook, pacing, retention, and visual engagement**
* Keep track of
 **current editing trends, Reel formats, visual styles, and internet culture**
* Take ownership of edits and build strong fine cuts without requiring step\-by\-step direction for every decision
* Collaborate with the creative and marketing team to execute content in line with brand and campaign needs
* Use relevant
 **AI tools** 
 to improve editing workflows, enhancement, clean\-up, subtitles, ideation, and productivity
* Manage multiple projects while maintaining
 **quality, consistency, and turnaround timelines**



  




 Experience
 
**Freshers are welcome to apply.** 




 But there is one condition.
 



 Your portfolio needs to be strong.
 



 We are far more interested in
 **what you can create** 
 than how many years you have been creating it.
 



 If your edits make us stop and think,
 



**“Okay. Who edited THIS?”** 




 we want to see them.
 



 Send us your
 **CV \+ your best editing portfolio/showreel** 
 .
 



 And please do not send every edit you have ever made.
 



**Send us the work you are genuinely proud of.** 




**Location** 




**iLEAD Kolkata** 




  





**To Apply** 




 Please share your
 **CV, portfolio/showreel, and relevant work links** 
 .

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world.  Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The Executive / Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – IT is responsible for ensuring the availability, stability and day\-to\-day support of IT infrastructure and end\-user systems across operational and administrative locations within the assigned region. The role coordinates IT support activities, manages vendor service delivery, resolves infrastructure issues and ensures minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

 Working closely with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, HR and Corporate IT teams, the role provides first and second\-level support for IT infrastructure, end\-user computing, hardware, software and network\-related issues while ensuring adherence to service levels, IT standards and information security requirements.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To provide reliable, responsive and efficient IT support across the assigned region by ensuring timely resolution of technology issues, effective vendor coordination, high system availability and uninterrupted business operations through proactive infrastructure support and adherence to IT governance standards.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Regional IT Operations Support**
* Provide day\-to\-day IT support across all operational and administrative locations within the assigned region, ensuring high system availability and minimal business disruption.
* Coordinate resolution of hardware, software, network and system\-related issues impacting business operations.
* Ensure operational locations receive timely IT support in accordance with defined service levels.
* Provide on\-site support for critical IT issues where remote resolution is not feasible.
* Support regional IT readiness for new branch openings, relocations, expansions and operational infrastructure changes.


**Incident \& Service Request Management**
* Manage IT incidents and service requests from logging through resolution, ensuring adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Prioritise and coordinate resolution of business\-critical incidents impacting operational continuity.
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting and coordinate with specialised support teams for second and third\-level issues.
* Track recurring incidents, identify root causes and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation, escalation records and service request updates.


**End User Computing \& Infrastructure Support**
* Support end\-user devices including desktops, laptops, printers, handheld devices, scanners and other operational IT equipment.
* Coordinate installation, configuration and maintenance of approved hardware, software and peripheral devices.
* Ensure timely provisioning and replacement of IT equipment for employees and operational locations.
* Support connectivity, user access, system availability and peripheral device functionality across the region.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance activities to maximise infrastructure reliability and equipment uptime.


**Vendor Management \& Service Delivery**
* Coordinate and monitor regional IT support vendors to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
* Track vendor performance against agreed SLAs and escalate service gaps where required.
* Validate completion of vendor activities and ensure quality of work performed.
* Coordinate warranty repairs, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) and third\-party support activities.
* Build effective working relationships with vendor partners to ensure uninterrupted IT support across the region.


**IT Asset \& Inventory Management**
* Maintain accurate records of regional IT assets including desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, handheld devices and networking equipment.
* Coordinate asset allocation, movement, replacement and disposal in accordance with organisational policies.
* Support periodic IT asset verification and inventory audits.
* Ensure software licensing, asset tagging and documentation remain accurate and up to date.
* Monitor asset lifecycle and recommend timely replacement of ageing or obsolete equipment.

* Coordinate with IT teams to ensure disaster recovery plans are fortified against ransomware and other cyber threats.

* Strong experience in risk management, business impact analysis, and incident response planning.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Arth Early Learning Spaces is a Reggio inspired preschool founded on the belief that all children are competent, capable, and eager to learn, and that every child deserves the opportunity to experience success in school.
 



  





 Arth was created as a space where learning is joyful and children love to come every day. The school’s name, “arth,” reflects the idea that children have a deep need to make sense of the world around them.

Daily responsibilities include setting up learning spaces, supporting routines such as arrival, meals, rest, and play, and maintaining a clean, organized classroom. The role also includes participating in team meetings, professional development, and school events to contribute to Arth’s collaborative learning community.

* Strong classroom facilitation and child\-centered teaching skills, with the ability to design and lead engaging activities for early learners.

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Early Childhood Education, Education, Psychology, or a related field is preferred.
* Comfort working on\-site in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with reliability, punctuality, and a collaborative, team\-oriented mindset.

title: Sizing Analyst
description:
**Department:** 
 Sales
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata / Gurgaon
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary:** 
 10\-12 LPA
 



  





**About Triphos** 




 Triphos Power is a full\-stack battery\-as\-a\-service company focused on commercial and industrial (C\&I) customers. We finance, own, deploy, operate, and maintain battery storage systems, backed by our own in\-house Energy Management System (EMS) — putting us at the intersection of system integration, battery portfolio management, and technology. Our target is 100 MWh across 30–40 C\&I sites in Year 1, scaling to a gigawatt\-hour\-plus portfolio within three years. We're backed by the promoter family of Rupa \& Co. and Neo Metaliks, giving us capital strength, distribution expertise, and a warm C\&I customer pipeline from day one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every Triphos proposal starts with a number: how much battery a site actually needs, and what it saves the customer. The Sizing Analyst owns that number. You'll work directly with C\&I clients to pull the load, tariff, and consumption data we need, clean it into something usable, and run the sizing and feasibility analysis behind every deal. Your output is the package the customer decides on — a full sizing report, a savings analysis, and a financial model with a clear ROI case. As we push toward 100 MWh across 30–40 sites in Year 1, this analysis is what separates a deal that closes and performs from one that doesn't.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the client data pipeline end to end — work through the data questionnaire with C\&I clients, understand exactly what's needed from each site, and follow up until it lands
* Clean, structure, and validate large, messy client datasets into analysis\-ready inputs
* Run sizing and optimization analysis to determine the right battery configuration for each site
* Determine which use case fits each client best — peak shaving, time\-of\-day arbitrage, renewable integration — based on what the data actually shows
* Research and interpret state tariff orders, electricity bills, penalty structures, and open access regulations to ground every analysis in real numbers
* Build savings analyses that quantify what the customer actually stands to gain
* Produce the full BESS feasibility analysis report for each site
* Communicate directly with clients throughout — chasing data, clarifying assumptions, and keeping the process moving
* Contribute to automating and streamlining the analysis process as we scale



  





**Key Requirements / Skills** 



* 0–3 years of experience
* BSc or higher in Operations Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field
* Strong expertise in Excel, Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools
* Strong with numbers, with a solid grounding in optimization, statistics, and sharp problem\-solving instincts
* Basic electrical knowledge, or willingness to pick it up quickly



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 Your analysis drives real investment decisions on both sides, so we want someone who feels that weight and checks their work accordingly.
 


* Meticulous — you go through data line by line because you know what rides on it
* Mathematically sharp, with the instinct to spot a number that looks wrong
* A clear communicator who builds rapport with clients and gets the data you need fast
* Comfortable working directly with C\&I customers
* High ownership and hands\-on, in a small, fast\-moving team



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your resume and a note under 200 words on why you think you are the right fit to hr@triphospower.com.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform — the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media \& entertainment company. We stream 650\+ Bengali movies, 185\+ originals, and 3000\+ hours of content to a global audience of \~250 million Bengalis across India, Bangladesh, and 100\+ countries. We're part of a wider ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI\-led micro\-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI\-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We're hiring a Senior Product Analyst to become the first dedicated owner of product analytics at hoichoi. We've been running PostHog for a few months, with real event data flowing across all platforms — what's missing is someone who digs into the data unprompted and turns it into a clear case for what we should change, and why. You'll sit inside the Product \& Data team and work closely with Engineering, Payments, and Programming to move two numbers: revenue and user experience.
 



  





 This is not a reporting service desk. As the first dedicated hire in this function, you will define how it works rather than inherit it. Your output is decisions, not dashboards — finding the exact step where a subscriber drops off, and owning a recommendation through to whether the number actually moved. We want someone who's done this before, checks the data before forming a view, and is comfortable reporting a flat result honestly. This is a full\-time, in\-office role based in Kolkata.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  





**Drop\-off Analysis** 



* Map every meaningful journey on every platform and find the exact step where users leave: onboarding, login and signup, search, content discovery, playback start, and the subscription funnel.
* Own the subscription funnel end to end — app open → paywall viewed → plan selected → payment initiated → payment success — split by platform, geography, and payment method.
* For every drop\-off found, report how many users and how much revenue it costs, why it's happening, and what specifically should change.
* Analyse payment failures and retry behaviour alongside the payments team.
* Track whether each recommended fix moved the number, and report plainly if it didn't.



**Retention, Churn \& Cohorts** 



* Build and maintain retention and cohort views — day\-1/7/30, trial\-to\-paid, renewal, and cancellation.
* Identify first\-session and first\-week behaviours that predict a subscriber sticking around, and recommend how to engineer more of them.



**Content \& Programming Analytics** 



* Report on content performance — tray impressions and clicks, play starts, completion rates, drop\-off curves, and search behaviour.
* Feed insights back to the programming team on what to promote, tray order, and whether an underperforming release was a content or merchandising issue.
* Support the internal Programming Analyst tooling built on top of PostHog.



**Experimentation** 



* Set up and read A/B tests and feature\-flag rollouts in PostHog — paywall variants, onboarding flows, tray layouts.
* Define success metrics and guardrail metrics up front, and call results honestly, including flat ones.



**Reporting Rhythm** 



* Run a weekly product metrics review that people actually read, and a monthly deep dive on one problem area of your choosing.
* Deliver release\-impact analysis after every major app release.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications :** 



* 4–6 years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data analysis on a consumer (B2C) product — app or web — including experience mentoring or setting standards for others.
* Hands\-on ownership of a product analytics tool (PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or similar) — has defined events, built funnels, and debugged bad data, not just consumed dashboards someone else built.
* Demonstrated ability to find drop\-offs and act on them, with a concrete example of a funnel fixed, what was found, what changed, and what it was worth.
* Solid grasp of funnels, cohorts, retention curves, and segmentation.
* Comfortable working with AI tooling day to day — specifically the PostHog MCP server with Claude — and able to get MCP running within a week if new to it.
* Willing to check the data and then take a decision: form a view, recommend it clearly, and own the outcome.
* Able to write a clear recommendation — what the data says, what to do about it, and how confident to be.
* Self\-directed, arriving with questions rather than waiting for answers.



  





  





**Candidates must have experience in any product analytics tool: PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap or similar.** 




  





**Why Join hoichoi** 




 You'll be the first dedicated product analytics hire at India's leading Bengali OTT platform — defining how the function works rather than inheriting someone else's playbook, with real event data across six platforms from day one. Every recommendation you make has a direct line to revenue and to how millions of viewers experience the product. hoichoi is going all\-in on becoming AI\-native, so you'll work daily with the PostHog MCP server and Claude as part of your core workflow, with a clear path to owning a growing analytics function as it scales.
 



  





**Culture \& How We Work** 




 At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross\-functional teams that argue productively and ship fast. Ownership isn't a buzzword here; it's the default setting — if something's broken, you fix it rather than filing a ticket and waiting.
 



  





 We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Some releases — particularly TV platform and store submissions — land outside standard hours, and we expect flexibility around those windows. We're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable the rest of the time.

**The Opportunity**
 As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce Technical Senior at EY GDS, you will contribute to the success of enterprise\-scale D365 F\&O implementations, primarily in the Retail and commerce domain. You will have the opportunity to work with a growing team and play a key role in delivering financial transformation solutions, process improvements, and ERP implementations to global clients, helping build a better working world.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through value\-driven consulting, technical leadership, and proactive engagement.
* Lead the technical design and development of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce solutions, with a focus on POS systems (MPOS/CPOS) \& B2C /B2B Website.
* Configure and extend Store Commerce, Hardware Station, and integrate peripherals such as printers, scanners, cash drawers, and payment devices.
* Configure and extend B2C \& B2B website, Site builder.
* Develop custom POS functionalities using Commerce SDK, Online SDK , TypeScript, JavaScript, C\#, and .NET Core.
* Implement integrations between POS and backend systems: ERP (F\&O), payment gateways, fiscal printers, loyalty programs, and eCommerce platforms.
* Design and maintain offline\-first POS architecture, ensuring performance, fault tolerance, and scalability across store networks.
* Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business needs into detailed technical designs and functional design documents (FDDs).
* Utilize Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS) for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management.
* Support system testing, performance tuning, deployment, and go\-live activities.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce best development practices, and maintain thorough technical documentation.
* Provide Level 3 support post\-go\-live to resolve POS\-related issues and ensure smooth store operations.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

* Familiarity with Power Platform, especially Power Apps and Power BI, is a plus.
* Ability to conceptualize and design future\-state business processes.
* Experience in conducting GAP analysis, solution testing, and user training.
* Good understanding of security roles, data management, Azure DevOps, and LCS environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Knowledge of integration with other Microsoft technologies such as Azure, Power Platform.
* Familiarity with industry\-specific retail practices and compliance requirements.
* Experience working in multi\-country and multi\-legal entity environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, manage offshore teams, and mentor junior consultants.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**What We Look For**
* 5–10 years of experience in D365 Commerce technical.
* Minimum 3 full\-cycle D365 F\&O implementations in Commerce domains.
* Strong domain knowledge of Retail \& eCommerce
* Strong domain knowledge of D365 Site builder tool
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with a focus on performance and reliability.
* Experience with Microsoft SureStep, Agile, or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Proficiency in working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders.
* Microsoft certifications such as MB\-340, MB\-900 are preferred.

description:

**Technical AI Product Engineer**
 4–7 Years \| Full\-time
   

  

 If you want to move beyond experiments and build AI systems that truly power products and decisions—this role is for you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are building next\-generation AI\-powered products and platforms that transform how businesses operate, make decisions, and engage with customers.
   

  

 As a Technical AI Product Engineer, you will design and deliver production\-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions—owning the full lifecycle from problem framing to deployment and continuous optimization.
   

  

 This role is ideal for engineers who combine deep AI/ML expertise with strong engineering rigor and product thinking, and want to build scalable, measurable, and responsible AI systems in a real\-world enterprise setting.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Build AI Products, Not Just Models**
* Design and develop GenAI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows
* Translate business problems into measurable AI\-driven outcomes
* Define evaluation metrics and product success criteria


**Engineer Intelligent Systems at Scale**
* Build and optimize retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines
* Develop agent\-based AI systems with tool usage and orchestration
* Deploy solutions on cloud\-native architectures (Azure preferred)


**Own the AI Lifecycle (GenAI Ops)**
* Implement prompt engineering strategies, embeddings, and fine\-tuning approaches
* Build evaluation frameworks and guardrails for reliability and safety
* Enable continuous monitoring of quality, latency, and cost


**Drive Responsible \& Secure AI**
* Embed responsible AI practices (bias detection, explainability, moderation)
* Ensure data privacy, governance, and compliance standards
* Build systems aligned with enterprise security and trust principles


**Collaborate \& influence**
* Partner with product, data, and engineering teams to prioritize AI features
* Influence enterprise AI architecture and best practices
* Enable teams through reusable AI components and APIs


**What You Bring**
**Must\-Have Skills**
* Strong programming in Python and SQL
* Hands\-on experience with GenAI patterns: Prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Embeddings \& semantic search, Agentic workflows
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks: PyTorch / TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain / Semantic Kernel
* Experience deploying AI solutions on cloud platforms (Azure preferred): Azure OpenAI, Azure ML , Azure AI Search


**Engineering \& Platform Skills**
* Strong foundation in data processing (Pandas, NumPy, Spark/Databricks)
* Experience with MLOps / GenAI Ops: MLflow, pipelines, CI/CD, Docker, Azure DevOps
* Experience building APIs and integrating AI into applications
* Understanding of monitoring, observability, and system reliability


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Experience building agent\-based or autonomous AI systems
* Cost optimization for LLM workloads
* Multi\-modal AI (text, image, voice)
* Frontend integration for AI\-driven experiences


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ Data Engineering, or related field
* 2\+ years of experience in AI engineering or development


**Additional**
* Certifications in AI, genAI or Ganetic AI
* Experience with data governance, security, and compliance standards

 We're looking for a
 **junior Training Executive** 
 to conduct and support training sessions for our retail sales staff, focused on customer service etiquette, grooming standards, and in\-depth product knowledge on our ethnic wear range (silk sarees, and related categories).

 required
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills
* Willingness to travel to store locations as needed

title: Manager- CSR Fundraising
description:
**Job Title: Manager / Sr. Associate / Sr. Manager \- Fund\-raising \& Corporate Partnerships** 




  





 Location: Goa/Ahmedabad/Kolkata/Jamshedpur
 



  





 Job Type: Full\-time
 



  





**About the Company: (e1 e1\)** 




  





 Each One and Educate One Foundation is a leading organization committed to making a positive impact on society through its various initiatives in the field of Education. Our mission is to drive sustainable development and community engagement through strategic partnerships and innovative scholarship programs.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




  





 The Fund\-raiser will play a crucial role in identifying and generating both Corporate and HNI leads for our Corporate \& Individual Social Responsibility initiatives. This role requires a proactive and dynamic individual who can generate leads, identify potential partners, build relationships, and convert them into active \& recurring engagements that align with our CSR \& Fund\-raising goals. The candidate must have a strong understanding of CSR Policies, Procedures, Processes, Compliance, Due Diligence, Impact Monitoring \& Reporting, combined with excellent networking skills, and the ability to engage with diverse stakeholders.
 



  





 Candidate should have an exposure to the Education Ecosystem in India (private \& public) and related Government policies and initiatives.
 



  





**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:** 




  




1. **Lead Generation:**



  




* Identify and research potential CSR partners \& Donors, including corporations, foundations in India \& abroad, Government agencies, and other relevant organizations.
* Generate and qualify leads through various channels, including online research, networking events, industry conferences, and referrals.
* Maintain a comprehensive database \& pipeline of potential partners, with robust follow\-up strategies \& methodologies including regular tracking \& reporting of all the outreach and engagement activities.



  




1. **Networking and Relationship Building:**



  




* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including CSR Personnel, CXOs, CEOs, Directors \& Manging Directors, influential Community Leaders, and Industry Leaders.
* Attend Industry events, CSR conferences \& awards functions, and relevant meetings to expand the organization’s network and CSR Partner base.
* Collaborate with internal teams to leverage existing relationships and identify new opportunities for partnerships.



  




1. **Strategic Planning:**



  




* Develop and implement strategies to effectively generate CSR interest in our interventions and realise partnership goals.
* Analyse market trends and industry developments to identify new opportunities for CSR engagement.
* Contribute to the development of CSR\-focused programs and initiatives by providing insights and recommendations based on lead generation \& CSR engagement activities.



  





**SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




1. **Communication and Outreach:**



  




* Prepare and deliver presentations, proposals, and curated pitches to potential partners.
* Create compelling marketing materials, including brochures, newsletters, and social media content, to build, expand, nurture and sustain CSR Partners and other potent fund\-raising avenues.
* Collaborate with the Communications team to develop and execute outreach campaigns targeting potential CSR partners.
