description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front\-end and back\-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack web applications using modern front\-end and back\-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server\-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non\-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front\-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:**

title: Advertising Account Manager
description:
As an advertising Account Manager, you'll work within an advertising or multi\-service agency, acting as a link between the agency and its clients. You'll be responsible for the coordination of advertising campaigns and therefore communicating clearly to all those involved. You may also be known as an account handler.
 



  





 It is vital to understand the needs of your clients, which you'll learn through liaising closely with them throughout campaigns, often on a daily basis. You'll also manage administrative and campaign work to ensure that advertising projects are completed on time and on budget.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 As an advertising Account Manager, you'll need to:
 


* meet and liaise with clients to discuss and identify their marketing requirements
* work with agency colleagues to devise an advertising campaign that meets the client's brief and budget
* present (alongside agency colleagues \- particularly the account manager) the campaign ideas and budget to the client
* work with the agency heads to brief media, creative and research staff and assist with the formulation of marketing strategies
* liaise with, and act as the link between, the client and the advertising agency by maintaining regular contact with both
* ensure that communication flows effectively
* negotiate with clients and agency staff about the details of campaigns
* present creative work to clients for approval or modification
* handle budgets, manage campaign costs, and invoice clients
* write client reports
* monitor the effectiveness of campaigns
* undertake administrative tasks
* arrange and attend meetings
* make pitches, along with other agency staff, with the aim of securing new business for the agency.



  





**What to expect** 



* Although you'll generally be office\-based, travel within the working day is frequent as you'll be expected to visit clients and may attend TV shoots, radio recordings or castings. Absence from home overnight and overseas work or travel is occasionally required.
* The working environment is generally informal, although the smart dress is often the norm. The role can involve socializing with clients.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Although this area of work is open to all graduates, a degree or HND in the following subjects may improve your chances, especially as advertising is an increasingly competitive sector to enter:
 


* advertising
* business/management
* communications
* English
* marketing



  





**Skills** 




 You will need to show evidence of the following:
 


* excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* a proactive attitude, with the ability to use initiative
* excellent organizational skills
* the ability to work under pressure and assimilate large quantities of information quickly, while maintaining attention to detail
* drive
* flexibility
* effective teamworking skills
* influencing and negotiation skills
* oral and written communication skills
* commercial awareness
* a passion for advertising and an understanding of what makes a good advertisement
* a willingness to learn
* resilience, to enable you to deal with problems and constructive criticism
* IT literacy and an awareness of how the industry is developing in light of new communication technologies.



  





 Please apply with your CV to ankit@meraqi.in

 **regular guests, events and revenue** 
 .
 



 This is not a traditional social\-media or community\-management role.
 



 The person will be responsible for
 **building the right community around Mehico, bringing people into the restaurant, curating commercially viable events and ensuring that every activation contributes to the business.** 




 The ideal candidate should know
 **where Kolkata's crowd is, who the key people are, what they like to do, and how to get them to Mehico.** 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Community Building
 * Build and manage a strong Mehico community comprising:
* Young professionals
* Entrepreneurs
* Corporate professionals
* Creatives
* Influencers
* Social groups
* College/alumni communities
* Lifestyle communities
* Nightlife crowd
* Event organisers
* Develop strong relationships with key people who can influence guest traffic.
* Maintain an active guest and community database.
* Convert one\-time visitors into regular Mehico guests.
* Build a community that identifies Mehico as a place to
 **meet, celebrate and socialise** 
 .


 2\. Guest Acquisition
 
 The primary objective is
 **bringing people through the door** 
 .
 


* Personally develop relationships with potential guests and community leaders.
* Drive guest traffic through networking and direct outreach.
* Create guest lists for events and ensure strong attendance.
* Develop partnerships with relevant communities, companies, clubs and groups.
* Drive repeat visits through personalised engagement.
* Track the number and quality of guests generated through each initiative.


 3\. Event Curation
 * Conceptualise and curate events that are relevant to Mehico's brand and target audience.
* Develop a monthly event calendar.
* Create recurring properties rather than one\-off events.
* Examples may include:
* Ladies' nights
* DJ nights
* Latin nights
* Salsa/Bachata evenings
* Corporate socials
* Networking evenings
* Community meet\-ups
* Themed parties
* Brand collaborations
* Influencer/community events
* Festive events
* Private parties
* Identify emerging trends and formats that can generate guest traffic.
* Work with the Operations, Bar, Kitchen and Marketing teams to execute events.


 4\. Commercial \& Revenue Responsibility
 
**Every event must have a commercial objective.** 




 The Community Manager will be responsible for ensuring that events are not conducted merely for visibility or social\-media content.
 



 For every event, the candidate should evaluate:
 


* Expected guest count
* Expected revenue
* Average spend per guest
* Food revenue
* Beverage revenue
* Event costs
* Artist/entertainment costs
* Marketing costs
* Complimentary/discount impact
* Contribution/profitability



 The candidate must be able to answer:
 



**"How much business will this event generate, what will it cost us, and what will we actually make?"** 



 5\. Event P\&L
 * Prepare event\-level revenue and cost projections.
* Track actual revenue against projections.
* Ensure events meet agreed profitability thresholds.
* Negotiate with artists, performers, collaborators and vendors within approved budgets.
* Avoid unnecessary complimentary spends and excessive discounts.
* Conduct post\-event profitability analysis.
* Identify which events should be repeated, modified or discontinued based on commercial performance.


 6\. Corporate \& Group Business
 * Build relationships with corporate organisations and HR/Admin teams.
* Generate corporate dinners, team outings, celebrations and networking events.
* Build relationships with event agencies and party planners.
* Develop group\-booking opportunities.
* Create corporate packages in coordination with the management team.
* Develop recurring corporate business rather than only one\-time bookings.


 7\. Partnerships \& Collaborations
 
 Identify and build partnerships with:
 


* Lifestyle brands
* Beverage brands
* Event companies
* DJs and artists
* Influencers
* Fitness/lifestyle communities
* Corporate groups
* Colleges and alumni groups
* Social clubs
* Travel and hospitality partners



 Partnerships should have a clear objective such as
 **guest acquisition, revenue generation, brand exposure or repeat business.** 



 8\. Guest Experience \& Retention
 * Be present at key events and personally engage with guests.
* Identify VIPs, influencers, regular guests and potential high\-value customers.
* Maintain relationships after events.
* Encourage repeat visits and referrals.
* Capture guest feedback and identify opportunities to improve the experience.
* Build a strong database with guest preferences, occasions and engagement history.


 IDEAL CANDIDATEExperience
 * **3–6 years of experience** 
 in community management, events, nightlife, hospitality, lifestyle, entertainment or business development.
* Experience in restaurants, bars, clubs, premium F\&B or lifestyle brands is preferred.
* Strong understanding of the
 **Kolkata social and nightlife ecosystem** 
 .


 Must\-Have
 
 The candidate should:
 


* **Know Kolkata's crowd.**
* Have an existing network or demonstrated ability to build one quickly.
* Be comfortable approaching people and building relationships.
* Have experience curating events.
* Understand what makes an event commercially successful.
* Be comfortable with sales and revenue targets.
* Understand basic P\&L and event profitability.
* Have strong negotiation skills.
* Be highly energetic and socially confident.
* Be hands\-on and present at events.
* Be able to convert relationships into actual business.


 IMPORTANT
 
**This is NOT a social\-media\-only Community Manager role.** 




 We are looking for someone who can:
 



**Build the community → Bring the guests → Curate the right events → Generate revenue → Control the costs → Make the events profitable.** 




 The candidate will be expected to have a
 **strong understanding of Kolkata's audience and social ecosystem** 
 and demonstrate how they can use their network and relationships to generate measurable business for Mehico.
 


 COMPENSATION
 
 Salary will be structured as
 **Fixed \+ Performance Incentive** 
 , with the variable component linked to agreed business and profitability targets.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nephrocare India is a premier renal care institute located in the heart of Kolkata, providing comprehensive treatment and support for a wide range of kidney\-related conditions. The institute offers holistic care for chronic and genetic kidney diseases, glomerular disorders, urological problems, and end\-stage renal disease, including dialysis and transplant services. Nephrocare is equipped with state\-of\-the\-art laboratory and diagnostic facilities (Carepath India), an in\-house pharmacy (Caremed India), world\-class radiological equipment, and daycare surgical services such as AV fistula and perm cath creation at affordable cost. The organization focuses on delivering complete, cost\-effective renal care, complemented by a cafeteria serving renal\-friendly cuisines and a pharmacy that offers genuine medicines at attractive discounts. Under it's umbrella it has one 100 beded hospital running in full swing 'Vivacity multispeciality hospitals' and numerous clinic and hospitals are in pipeline.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will provide strategic and operational leadership for all technology initiatives at Nephrocare India, ensuring that digital solutions effectively support clinical care, diagnostics, patient experience, and business operations. This full\-time, on\-site role in Kolkata involves overseeing software and product development, defining and implementing IT strategy, and guiding technology architecture to align with organizational goals and regulatory requirements. The CTO will manage technology projects end\-to\-end, collaborate with clinical and administrative stakeholders, and ensure robust, secure, and scalable systems for electronic health records, diagnostic platforms, and internal tools. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include leading and mentoring technology teams, evaluating and integrating new technologies, managing vendor relationships, optimizing infrastructure and cybersecurity, and driving continuous improvement in digital workflows and data management.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong expertise in Software Development and Product Development, with experience delivering healthcare or enterprise\-grade applications.
* Demonstrated skills in IT Strategy and Architecture, including designing scalable, secure, and interoperable systems.
* Proven Project Management capabilities, overseeing complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives from concept to deployment.
* Extensive leadership experience in a senior technology role, preferably as CTO, VP Engineering, or similar, in healthcare or related sectors.
* Solid understanding of healthcare workflows, health care software, Zoho, Tally, software migration, software integration, data privacy, and compliance standards (e.g., medical data security and local regulatory requirements).
* Ability to collaborate effectively with medical, operational, and executive teams, and to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience with cloud platforms, cybersecurity best practices, data analytics, and integration of diagnostic or medical devices is highly beneficial.
* Relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Head of Fundraising
description:
**Head of Fundraising \& Investor Relations, East – Kolkata** 




 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP
 



  





**Vantrock is a multi\-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund.** 
 Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre\-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the distribution network for all of it in Kolkata and the East.
 



**THE SEAT** 




**Employer:** 
 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures
 



**Reports to:** 
 Chief Business Officer, Fundraising and Investor Relations. Until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder \& CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands\-on
 



**Direct reports:** 
 None at launch. A senior single\-contributor seat with a very large number attached
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata, in office, with twelve to fifteen travel days a month across Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur
 



**Experience:** 
 10 to 16 years
 



 Team structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.
 



**ABOUT THE COMPANY** 




 Vantrock is an operator\-led real assets platform, and it is multi\-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are
 **the first strategy, not the platform** 
 , across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use with distribution below and office above.
 



 Behind that first strategy sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and its own distributor relationships behind it.
 **A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.** 




 Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de\-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited develops and operates; Vantrock Investment Managers LLP underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The platform earns only after its investors have.
 



 Founded by
 **Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO** 
 . Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1\.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000\+ acres acquired, all litigation\-free; 200\+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



**Warehousing is where the founder is best known. It is not where this platform stops.** 
 That record is the anchor that opens the door in the channel. The mandate you would be selling is considerably wider than it.
 



 We hire number twos who want to become number one.
 



**THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE SELLING** 




 This is the part most candidates get wrong. You would not be carrying one product into the channel. You would be building a channel that carries a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:
 



 – Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing
 



 – Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, starter and strata office
 



 – Plotted and industrial plot sales
 



 – Pre\-leased and yielding assets
 



 – A land strategy
 



 – Private credit
 



 – Data centres and senior living
 



 – In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structures
 



**Multiple product lines, one channel.** 
 That is why this is a franchise\-building job rather than a product\-selling job. An RM you certify on the first strategy sells the second, third and fourth without being recruited again.
 



 The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal\-by\-deal co\-investment through CIV, co\-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de\-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co\-investment tickets into named assets.
 



**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




**Own the zone.** 
 Build the distribution and IFA network across East and North\-East India: Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur. Activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert that network into committed capital for the first strategy and into a channel that is ready when the office, plotted, land, credit and yielding strategies arrive behind it.
 



**Not a cold start.** 
 The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls. There is no team to delegate that to in Year 1\. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.
 



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




 – The network. National distributors' regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi\-family offices and wealth\-platform desks. Target 5 to 7 firms empanelled and live.
 



 – The full empanelment cycle, locally. First meeting to product committee to go\-live, for both the fund and the co\-investment routes. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not start the cycle again.
 



 – Activation. Branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 35 to 50 RMs and IFAs have each placed at least one ticket.
 



 – Conversion. Joint client meetings as the core of the job. The pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.
 



 – The map, in the CRM, weekly. Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations. The face of Vantrock in the East.
 



**THIS IS A FRONT\-FACING SEAT** 




 You do not sell to the distributors and stop. You sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to their clients and pitch yourself. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits, speak where the channel meets the asset class, and be a named voice of the platform on LinkedIn.
 



**Approved material only. Nothing bespoke, nothing verbal\-only, no return promises, ever.** 




**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Essential** 




 – 10 to 16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual\-fund products from the manufacturer's side, an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.
 



 – Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA and MFD firms in East and North\-East India. You can name them, and they will take your call.
 



 – You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once, not only carried an established brand.
 



 – Third\-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not assets influenced.
 



 – Graduate. MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent. NISM as applicable.
 



 – Appetite for the road. Twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.
 



**Advantageous** 




 – A real assets fund background. Not mandatory: a strong alternatives channel salesperson from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire, because channel sales is harder to teach than an asset class.
 



 – Experience carrying more than one product line into the same channel. This platform will ask you to do it repeatedly.
 



 – An AMC alternates or PMS desk. Co\-investment tickets sold alongside a fund. Standing in the Marwari, Bengali and North\-East business communities, where alternatives penetration is low relative to wealth and a well\-run fund house faces less competition.
 



**COMPENSATION AND WEALTH CREATION** 




 Benchmarked against the upper quartile, then deliberately weighted from take\-home to wealth creation. Four parts, offered as a mix: fixed; a fundraising incentive on the capital you personally bring in, with a team component on the platform's total raise; a share in the platform's additional returns on strategies you help close; and ESOPs. Numbers in the first conversation.
 



**Prepared for recruitment only. Not an offer of, or invitation to invest in, any fund, scheme, security or interest, and not marketing of any investment product. The product lines, structures and routes described are proposed and indicative, subject to change and to all necessary SEBI and other regulatory approvals. The track record above relates to the founder's prior roles at other organisations, is not the track record of Vantrock, and is not indicative of future results. No return is stated or implied, and none may be quoted in connection with this search.** 




 Approve and West follows.

title: Senior Creative Strategist
description:
We are looking for a
 **Senior Creative Strategist** 
 who lives and breathes consumer brands, content and culture.
 



  





 Someone who instinctively notices a great ad. Someone who knows what brands are doing right, what feels dated, what is starting to trend and, more importantly,
 **why something works with an audience.** 




  





 This is not a role for someone who simply wants to make more content.
 



  





 We are looking for someone with
 **strong creative taste, sharp consumer understanding and the ability** 




**to turn insights into ideas.** 
 You should be equally comfortable thinking about a campaign, writing a copy
 



 line, breaking down a reel, spotting a cultural trend or explaining why a particular creative will—or won't—
 



 resonate with a 20\-year\-old.
 



  





 You will play a key role in shaping how the brand communicates across social media, campaigns, digital
 



 platforms and other consumer\-facing touchpoints.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





**1\. Own Creative Strategy** 




  




* Develop creative ideas and strategies across campaigns, social media, digital and brand initiatives.
* Translate business objectives into consumer\-relevant creative communication.
* Develop creative territories, concepts and campaign ideas that are distinctive and relevant.
* Work closely with designers, video teams, copywriters and marketing teams to bring ideas to life.
* Ensure that creative output is not just aesthetically good, but has a clear consumer insight and
* strategic thought behind it.



  





**2\. Understand the Consumer** 




  




* Develop a deep understanding of the 18–30\-year\-old consumer—their aspirations, behavior,
* language, interests, culture and attention patterns.
* Understand what makes people stop scrolling, engage, share, save and remember.



  





**3\. Build Creative Taste** 




  




* Develop and maintain a strong point of view on what good creative looks like for the brand.
* Challenge work that feels generic, derivative, overly promotional or disconnected from the audience.
* Build a strong repository of references from consumer brands, advertising, creators, entertainment
* and popular culture.
* Constantly raise the creative bar across the organisation.



  





**4\. Connect Creativity With Business** 




  




* Understand the business objective behind every creative brief.
* Connect business problems → consumer insights → creative ideas → communication.
* Collaborate with marketing, product and business teams to understand what needs to be
* communicated and find the most compelling way to communicate it.
* Balance creativity with commercial thinking.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




**﻿** 



* 2\+ years of experience in a creative strategy, brand, content, advertising or similar role.
* Mandatory experience in a consumer\-facing brand or agency.
* Strong understanding of copy, content and visual communication.
* Excellent writing and communication skills.
* A strong understanding of social media and digital content formats.
* Deep curiosity about consumer behavior and culture.
* Strong understanding of the 18–30 age group and how they consume content.
* A sharp eye for what is culturally relevant, interesting and differentiated.
* The ability to articulate why an idea works—not just whether you like it.
* Strong creative judgement and excellent taste.
* Ability to move between strategic thinking and hands\-on execution.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where ideas need to be developed, tested and
* iterated quickly.

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
**About the role:** 





 Zeltis works on communicating the Government of West Bengal’s schemes, initiatives, events and priority messages to the people of the State through simple, accessible video and graphic content.
 





 We are looking for a
 
**Senior Copywriter** 

 who can anchor the written word in that process. The job is to take policy; often dense, technical and written for administrators and turn it into language that a farmer in Purulia, a student in Siliguri and a homemaker in Howrah can easily understand. This is not advertising for its own sake; it is public communication and it carries the weight and responsibility of the Government’s voice.
 





 The role is suited to someone who reads and analyzes the news out of genuine interest, who can tell the difference between a claim and a fact and who can write a line that lands without ever overstating or understating what the Government has actually said. 
 





 At Zeltis, we are looking for someone who brings curiosity, clarity and editorial judgement to every piece of content they write.
 




**Experience:** 

 3 to 5 years minimum prior experience as a content writer in governance, political, journalistic, research\-driven or critical/analytical environments. Candidates from newsrooms, policy institutions, think tanks, research organisations, editorial desks or long\-form publications will be strongly preferred, as the role demands accuracy and depth alongside creative flair.
 




**Key responsibilities:** 



* Translate scheme documents, policy notes, press releases and departmental briefs into clear, simple, people\-facing copy in Bengali and English.
* Write scripts (explainers, reels, testimonials, event films), voice\-over copy, graphic and creative copy, campaign taglines and punchlines.
* Produce copy that reads natively, with the idiom, rhythm and cultural texture appropriate to each, rather than a literal rendering of the other.
* Proactively ideate content and campaigns; identify communication opportunities before they are assigned and propose the narrative angle for them.
* Manage narrative consistently across campaigns and ensure the Government's initiatives are communicated positively, accurately and in a single coherent voice.
* Brief and work alongside the design, motion and video teams; ensure copy and visual treatment work together rather than in parallel.
* Deliver rapid\-response copy during announcements, events, launches and time\-sensitive situations.
* Act as the final quality check on outgoing copy to ensure factual accuracy, official nomenclature, scheme names, figures, spellings, grammar and tone.
* Guide and review the work of junior copywriters and maintain the unit's style and terminology standards.
* Maintain strict confidentiality on all unreleased communication, data and internal material.



**Essential skills and requirements:** 



* **Genuine understanding and interest in governance and policy:** 

 Demonstrable understanding of, knowledge of, or serious interest in governance, public policy and welfare delivery. Follows news \- State, local and National as a daily habit and can hold an informed conversation about the same.
* **Understands the sensitivity of government communication:** 

 Understands that government communication is not just another brand of communication. Appreciates the protocols, the factual discipline, the political and administrative sensitivities involved and the lines that must not be crossed. Exercises judgement about what can be said, how and when.
* **Simplification for the layman:** 

 Proven ability to convert technical, administrative and policy language into simple, everyday terms; copy that connects with a general audience across literacy levels, age groups and districts, without diluting or misrepresenting the facts.
* **Language command:** 

 Fluency in Bengali and English, publication\-standard writing, with the ability to write original copy. Hindi proficiency is optional but desirable.
* **Keen eye for detail and error identification:** 

 Catches factual slips, wrong figures, wrong scheme names, grammatical and typographical errors and inconsistencies in tone before anything goes out. A single error in government communication carries a disproportionate cost.
* **Creative writing and punchline ideation:** 

 Can produce memorable, sharp, quotable lines and headlines; slogans, hooks, taglines, captions that travel well on social platforms.
* **Proactive ideation and narrative management:** 

 Brings ideas to the table unprompted. Thinks in terms of campaigns and arcs, not one\-off posts and can shape a sustained positive narrative around the Government's work.
* **Availability and work commitment:** 

 Government work is unpredictable and often urgent. The role requires genuine willingness and enthusiasm to work beyond designated hours, including evenings, weekends and public holidays, when the situation demands.



**Good to have:** 



* Ad copywriting experience: Experience in writing campaign copy, print, OOH, digital and film.
* Agency experience: Familiarity with client servicing, brief\-taking, deadline culture and working within a creative team.
* Creative writing credentials: Published work, long\-form storytelling, literary or scripting background.
* Working knowledge of social media platform policies: Community guidelines, content restrictions and compliance requirements across Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube and WhatsApp.
* Understanding of platform algorithms: What drives reach, retention and engagement and how copy choices affect distribution.



  





**Remuneration: I** 

 ndustry standard, commensurate with experience, portfolio and interview performance
 




***This is an on\-site role and the candidate must travel to and work from the office***




  





***Applicants are requested to apply at***
*hr@zeltis.co.in* 
***along with submission of any one assignments mentioned below (Pick any one):***



1. *There is a lot of negative publicity surrounding Annapurna Yojana owing to the delay in payments. Even though the reason is logical administratively speaking, common people do not understand that. Hence, your task is to prepare a one\-minute content script for a video that will be published through Government or Department page; positively promoting the Annapurna Yojana which is not misleading \[in Bengali]*
2. *Write a video script on PM Surya Ghar Yojana with the intention of urging people to apply for the scheme through listing out its benefits. Common people find it boring to look through the pages of scheme documents, guidelines and websites; hence write the script in a manner like it appeals to the layman with the lucrative side of the scheme; without any half information or misinformation \[in Bengali]*

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd. (MOFSL) is a diversified financial services firm offering solutions across Private Wealth, Retail and Institutional Broking, Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Commodities, Currencies, and Home Finance. Founded in 1987, MOFSL has grown into a 12,000\+ member team with a strong focus on customer\-first service, ethical practices, professional excellence, and technology\-driven innovation. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company serves over 5\.2 million customers through a network of 2,500\+ business locations across 550 cities and towns. MOFSL is widely recognized for its research\-based advice, investing nearly 10% of its revenue in equity research, and has a dedicated team of 25\+ analysts covering more than 250 companies across 20 sectors. Its commitment to quality research and client service has earned multiple industry awards, including repeated recognition as Best Performing Equity Broker (National) and induction into the Hall of Fame at the Financial Advisory Awards.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role is based in Kolkata. The Relationship Manager will be responsible for acquisition of clients, including retail and high net worth individuals, by understanding their financial goals and recommending suitable products and services. Daily activities include client onboarding, portfolio review meetings, proactive follow\-ups, and handling client queries and service requests in a timely and professional manner. The role involves coordinating with internal teams for trade execution, product information, and research insights, while ensuring regulatory and compliance standards are met. The Relationship Manager will also focus on business development through lead generation, cross\-selling, and building long\-term, trust\-based client relationships.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong client relationship management and customer service skills, including the ability to build trust, handle queries, and maintain long\-term engagement.
* Candidates should possess sales and business development skills, such as lead generation, cross\-selling, and achieving revenue and portfolio growth targets.
* Candidates should possess sound knowledge of financial markets and investment products, including equities, mutual funds, and other wealth management solutions.
* Candidates should possess communication and interpersonal skills, including clear verbal and written communication, presentation abilities, and active listening.
* Candidates should possess analytical and problem\-solving skills to interpret client needs, use research insights, and recommend appropriate financial strategies.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related field; relevant certifications in securities or wealth management are an advantage.
* Prior experience in broking, wealth management, or financial advisory roles is preferred; familiarity with regulatory requirements and SEBI norms is beneficial.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer with 4\-8 years of overall experience to design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI systems. The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on expertise in Python, Generative AI and Agentic AI, backed by a solid foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Transformer architectures. This is a hands\-on role where you will be expected to operate as a strong individual contributor while also being able to work at a lead capacity, engaging directly stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Own features end\-to\-end, from problem framing and model development to API design, deployment, and scaling on the cloud.
* Design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI systems.
* Engage directly with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Design and develop REST/APIs and integrate AI models into services.
* Scale applications and optimize performance for high\-volume workloads.
* Deploy and operate models/services in production environments (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).
* Operate as a strong individual contributor and lead at a stakeholder engagement capacity.
* Guide and mentor junior engineers.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4\-8 years of overall hands\-on experience in software/AI engineering (not limited to Generative AI).
* Proven track record of delivering production\-grade AI/ML solutions.
* Very strong proficiency in Python and its AI/ML ecosystem.
* Solid hands\-on experience with Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, fine\-tuning).
* Strong foundation in Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts and techniques.
* Good working knowledge of NLP and Transformer\-based architectures.
* Production\-grade experience designing and developing REST/APIs and integrating AI models into services.
* Demonstrated experience in scaling applications and optimizing performance for high\-volume workloads.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services.
* Experience in deploying and operating models/services in production environments (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Hands\-on experience building Agentic AI systems (multi\-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, autonomous workflows).
* Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen.
* Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Azure AI Search).
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps practices and tooling.
* Experience with Docker/Kubernetes.
* Exposure to Azure AI/OpenAI services, Azure ML, and serverless deployments.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.


**What We Look For**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery\-focused mindset.
* Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Mineral Processing - Design Engineer
description:
* Develop process flow diagrams (PFDs) and piping \& instrumentation diagrams (P\&IDs).
* Design mineral processing circuits including crushing, grinding, classification, flotation, leaching, and dewatering.
* Select appropriate technologies and equipment based on ore characteristics and project goals.
* Create detailed plant layouts using CAD tools.
* Collaborate with civil, structural, mechanical, and electrical engineers to integrate systems.
* Ensure designs comply with industry standards and safety regulations.
* Conduct feasibility studies and techno\-economic evaluations.
* Perform mass balance and water balance calculations.
* Simulate process performance using modeling softwares. Provide engineering support during construction, commissioning, and ramp\-up phases.
* Review vendor drawings and specifications.
* Coordinate with procurement and construction teams to ensure timely delivery of equipment
* Integrate environmental and sustainability considerations into plant design.
* Ensure compliance with local and international mining regulations.
* Design systems for dust control, water recycling, and tailings management.

title: Specialist Manager - Growth and Development (Consulting)
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 At Deloitte, we are known for setting a standard of excellence \-\- and for the people delivering it! The Learning \& Development team delivers value through business\-focused, efficient, and innovative learning, performance, and development solutions and by building the world’s best leaders. Structured to achieve tight alignment with the businesses while advancing Deloitte’s brand in the marketplace, this team consists of dedicated Development Advisors and Subject Matter Advisors (SMAs).
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Specialist Manager, Talent Development on the Learning \& Development team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Partnering with business stakeholders to identify capability needs and align learning solutions to business priorities.
* Leading the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of learning programs, onboarding, and development journeys across the Consulting portfolio.
* Managing end\-to\-end program operations, including stakeholder coordination, facilitator onboarding, vendor management, communications, and delivery support.
* Overseeing budget planning, forecasting, spend tracking, reporting, and accrual management for learning and development initiatives.
* Using learning metrics, analytics, and feedback to assess program effectiveness, publish scorecards, and drive continuous improvement.


**The team**
 In our US India offices, the Learning \& Development team supports capability development, professional networking and career progression for the region's professionals. The team specializes in connecting the dots between internal and external team members to provide a wholistic learning solution to business and come across as one.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Gurugram**
**Shift Timings: 9 AM to 6 PM**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree.
* DTD (ISTD), Master of Business Administration (MBA), Post Graduate Diploma in Business Administration (PGDBA), Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management (PGDBM), or equivalent postgraduate degree.
* 10\+ years of experience in learning and development or talent development in matrixed organizations supporting international markets.
* Experience with training process management, training needs identification, learning strategy, and learning design for technology\-focused programs.
* Experience with vendor management, project management, cross\-border stakeholder management, and financial management.
* Experience planning and delivering learning programs across multiple locations.
* Experience using Microsoft Office tools, including Microsoft Excel, for analysis, reporting, and metrics tracking.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience defining and measuring business impact for learning initiatives.
* Experience applying adult learning theories or frameworks in program design and delivery.
* Experience analyzing performance or learning data to identify gaps and validate hypotheses.
* Experience supporting technology\-focused capability development programs.
* Experience working with learning technologies and enabling adoption of new tools in learning environments.


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**

The team members also receive on\-the\-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. **To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 1\+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi\-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx etc, will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)
